decisions.reason: Although this waterproof lined safety shoe range fits the firm’s core footwear knowledge and could in principle be improved through its in-house R&D, its appearance only at launch and no visible continuation by 2021 suggest weak enough market traction or replacement that resources are better reallocated.

This electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe is closely related to the firm’s established competences, but the lack of website presence after 2019 indicates the firm likely did not see sufficient results worth further learning and commercialization effort.

The safety shoe series is highly aligned with existing capabilities, yet with no evidence of continued market communication beyond the launch year, management should treat it as an unsuccessful or superseded line and shift resources to stronger core ranges and new development.
